## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what users will observe after this change.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. For translation-rule changes, include a realistic source, the task instructions, and observed output when available. Label unexecuted examples clearly.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused purpose and preserves explicit user requirements.
- [ ] Relevant tool regressions or behavioral examples are included.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated in Chinese and English where needed.
- [ ] The contribution contains no secrets, private data, or content I lack permission to share.
- [ ] Validation claims distinguish deterministic checks from model translation quality.
